pick.name: logo-design skill (Claude)
pick.what: Brief -> concepts -> hand-built geometric SVG -> tests (16 px, mono, reversed) -> brand kit, with audit/export scripts
pick.why: Generates editable SVG marks plus usage guidelines inside Claude Code, so files live in the repo.
pick.free_limits: Skill is free (MIT); running it needs Claude Code access (paid Claude plan or API billing). Output is SVG you own
pick.license: MIT (reference logo SVGs are third-party trademarks)

best_free.name: Inkscape (hand-built vector logo)
best_free.why: Free commercial-safe route: build the mark yourself, GPL app, output is yours.

alts.name: Recraft
alts.what: AI vector and brand image generator
alts.why: Free-plan images are not licensed for commercial use and are public; paid plans give full commercial rights and private outputs.
alts.free_limits: Free plan: public images, not licensed for commercial use (per pricing page); credits per month not stated

alts.name: Looka
alts.what: AI logo maker with brand kit
alts.why: Fast one-time logo packages; terms not verified.

candidates.name: logo-design skill (Claude)
candidates.verdict: pick: SVG marks, tests and guidelines in-repo

decision: An agent-built SVG mark plus guidelines is fast and keeps files in your repo; a freelance designer is better for a brand that will carry the company. Do not ship Recraft free-plan output commercially.
details: Do not ship AI raster logos: they are hard to trademark and do not scale.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
